reading_note: The teaching traces the discrete degrees by which the Divine descends from its inmost into the natural — the Father (inmost celestial good in concealment), the First Man (divine truth sent into the realm of self-love), the Mother of Life (the matrix from which spiritual life is born), the Living Spirit/Great Builder (the operative power that frames spiritual order), the Third Ambassador with the Pillar of Glory (the call that awakens trapped good), and Jesus the Radiance (divine truth descending to Adam, i.e. to the natural human). The middle of the arc is judicial: the King of Lights sends a pure judge against the King of Darkness (the ruling love of self) who violated the First Man, binding the archons (false affections) each to their proper place according to their evil. The end describes Jesus the Radiance reaching the molding of Adam and Eve — the regeneration of the natural mind — and the final gathering of all light back into the Body, the consummation in which the Living Spirit awakens his soul, casts off defilement, and unites all good and truth in his own image forever. The single arc: divine love descending through discrete degrees to rescue and finally re-gather what fell into the natural.
